paragraphs: Communico sells an integrated suite of cloud applications built specifically for libraries. The company counts ten enterprise modules in the platform.

The content management module lets library staff build websites, email landing pages, microsites, blogs, intranets, reference guides and kiosks with or without coding skills. An events module simplifies program creation and controls who may publish to the public calendar. A scheduling module handles appointments for services from curbside pickup and tutoring to exam proctoring and tech help. Other modules cover digital signage that turns any screen into a display, and native iOS and Android apps for patrons. A central control panel pushes updates automatically across the whole platform.

More than 400 libraries have partnered with the company. Its founder describes starting the company to give libraries intuitive tools for connecting with their communities. The company reports that five of its modules received platinum in the 2022-24 Modern Library Awards.

quote.text: Communico was founded with a simple mission: to give libraries the powerful, intuitive tools they deserve to connect with their communities.
